headline: Pomegg Choice
title: Pomegg Evolution | Pomawk or Dazmand | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Pomegg looks like an egg, but it evolves two ways. At level twenty five it can become Pomawk, a Grass and Ice breaker. Add a Roar Stone at level twenty five and it becomes Dazmand instead, a Lightning support. Both branches start from the same little shell. Which form fits your team? Comment below!
description: Pomegg evolution in Aniimo: Pomawk at level 25, or Dazmand at level 25 with a Roar Stone. Pomawk is a Grass and Ice breaker, Dazmand a Lightning support.
joke: Pomegg hides in a shell and still gets mistaken for breakfast.
